scenario_title_zh: 纱线采购与 Uster 报告纠纷

rounds.ai_message: Good morning. This is Lisa from Shandong Yibin Yarn. How can I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好，我是山东宜宾纱业的 Lisa，请问有什么可以帮您？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍，说明用途和大致纱支
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want buy yarn'; say 'I am looking for yarn' or 'I want to buy yarn'.
rounds.tips_zh: 电话咨询纱线时先报公司、用途和大致规格。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Lisa. This is Mark from Hangzhou Lily Garments. We are looking for combed cotton yarn for our SS26 T-shirt line.

rounds.ai_message: Sure, Mark. We have carded, combed and compact yarn. What yarn count do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的 Mark。我们有普梳、精梳和紧密纺。请问你需要多少支？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明纱支数与纺纱方式
rounds.common_mistakes: yarn count 不要说成 yarn number；常用 32s、40s。
rounds.tips_zh: T 恤常用 26s-32s 精梳棉；高支 40s 用于高档 T 恤。
rounds.user_response_example: We need combed cotton, around 32s. Ring spun is fine.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. 32s combed is one of our best sellers. What about the twist — regular or low twist?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。32 支精梳是我们的主力款。捻度方面要常规还是低捻？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答捻度偏好
rounds.common_mistakes: twist 在口语里直接说 twist；TPM / TPI 是书面单位。
rounds.tips_zh: 常规 T 恤用 4.0-4.5 TPM；高捻偏挺括、低捻偏柔软。
rounds.user_response_example: Regular twist, around 4 TPM, please. We want a soft but not too drapy handfeel.

rounds.ai_message: OK. How many colors and what is the total quantity? Our MOQ for dyed yarn is 300 kg per color.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。需要几个颜色？总数量多少？我们染色纱 MOQ 是每色 300 公斤。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明颜色数量和下单量
rounds.common_mistakes: 纱线 MOQ 以 kg 为单位，不是件。
rounds.tips_zh: 染色纱每色 200-500 kg 是常见区间；本白纱通常 1 吨起。
rounds.user_response_example: We have 4 colors this season. The total quantity is around 3,000 kg. 300 kg per color works for us.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. Please send the Pantone TCX numbers. For lab dips we use TCX, not TPG.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。请发潘通 TCX 色号。打色样我们用 TCX，不用 TPG。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认发送潘通色号
rounds.common_mistakes: TCX 是纺织色卡，TPG 是印刷色卡，不要混发。
rounds.tips_zh: 服装对色一定要用纺织潘通 TPX/TCX，印刷 TPG 颜色会偏。
rounds.user_response_example: Sure, I will email the 4 Pantone TCX numbers this afternoon. The main color is 19-4052 navy.

rounds.ai_message: Great. After we receive the Pantone, lab dips take 3 to 5 days. For 3,000 kg of 32s combed, the price is around US$3.80 per kg. Lead time is 20 days after lab dip approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。收到潘通后 3-5 天可出对色样。3,000 公斤 32 支精梳，价格约每公斤 3.8 美元。批色样后 20 天出货。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认价格与交期，尝试议价
rounds.common_mistakes: lead time 后要接 after the lab dip approval 才完整。
rounds.tips_zh: 大单可压价；3 吨以上通常有 3-5% 让价空间。
rounds.user_response_example: Lead time is fine. For 3,000 kg, could you do US$3.65 per kg? We may have repeat orders next season.

rounds.ai_message: I can come down a little, maybe US$3.70, but no more. Yarn price has gone up recently. Cones or hanks?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我可以稍降一点，3.7 美元，但不能再低了。最近纱价涨了。筒子纱还是绞纱？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认包装方式
rounds.common_mistakes: cone / cheese / hank 是三种卷装；cone 是最常用筒纱。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织厂一般用筒子纱 cone，常见筒重 1 kg、1.5 kg、2 kg。
rounds.user_response_example: Cones, please. 2 kg per cone is our standard. Please confirm cone weight on the proforma invoice.

rounds.ai_message: Noted. I will send the PI tomorrow. After you confirm, lab dip starts, and bulk 20 days after lab dip approval. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 记下。我明天发 PI。确认后启动打色样，批色样后 20 天大货。还有别的吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认收件邮箱，结束通话
rounds.common_mistakes: PI = Proforma Invoice，不要说成 formal invoice。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 上要写清 trade term、payment、validity、bank info，是后续付款和清关基础。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send the PI to mark@lilygarments.com. Looking forward to the lab dips. Have a nice day, Lisa.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, Lisa from Yibin Yarn here. I saw your RFQ for 32s combed cotton. Before I quote, may I ask what end-use and what spinning method you prefer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是宜宾纱业 Lisa。看到你 32 支精梳棉的 RFQ，报价前能问一下用途和纺纱方式吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明用途、面料类型、纺纱方式
rounds.common_mistakes: end-use 不要说 'for T-shirt' 而省略纺纱方式；合一起描述。
rounds.tips_zh: 不同纺纱方式价格差很多：OE 便宜、ring spun 中端、compact 最贵。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Lisa. The yarn is for 160 GSM single jersey T-shirts. Compact yarn is preferred for cleaner surface, but ring spun is acceptable if the price is competitive.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Compact 32s will be US$4.10 per kg; ring spun 32s is US$3.80. MOQ for compact is 500 kg per color. Which would you like?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。紧密纺 32 支每公斤 4.1 美元；环锭纺 32 支 3.8 美元。紧密纺 MOQ 每色 500 公斤。请问要哪种？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在价格与品质间做选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要简单说 'any is fine'；按终端用途选。
rounds.tips_zh: 紧密纺毛羽少、光洁，适合深色 T 恤；浅色可用环锭纺。
rounds.user_response_example: The main color is dark navy, so let's go with compact for cleaner surface. 500 kg per color works.

rounds.ai_message: Good choice. About twist, we usually do Z-twist 4.2 TPM for compact 32s. Will that work, or do you need a specific TPM?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明智的选择。紧密纺 32 支我们常规做 Z 捻 4.2 TPM。可以吗？还是要指定 TPM？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认捻向与 TPM
rounds.common_mistakes: TPM（每米捻数）和 TPI（每英寸捻数）别混用。
rounds.tips_zh: 棉纺单纱默认 Z 捻；T 恤用 4.0-4.5 TPM 是常见区间。
rounds.user_response_example: Z-twist is fine. Around 4 TPM works for us. We don't need to specify TPI for this order.

rounds.ai_message: OK. We will attach the Uster test certificate with each shipment — covering CV%, IPI, hairiness and count CV%. Anything specific you need on the report?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。每批货我们附 Uster 检测报告——含 CV%、IPI、毛羽和支数 CV%。报告上需要特别写明哪些？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明对 Uster 报告的指标要求
rounds.common_mistakes: Uster CV% 数字越小越好；不同支数标准不同。
rounds.tips_zh: 30s 精梳棉常见标准：Uster CV% ≤13.5、IPI ≤150/km、毛羽 H ≤5.5。
rounds.user_response_example: We need Uster CV% below 13.5, IPI below 150 per km, and hairiness index H below 5.5. Please also include tenacity in cN/tex.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. One concern — last season your colleague raised an IPI claim on lot #A203. Do you want me to run a Uster Statistics Bulletin comparison this time?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。提醒一下——上季度你同事对 A203 批次的 IPI 提出过索赔。这次要不要我做一份 Uster 统计公报对比？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应历史问题，确认加强 QC
rounds.common_mistakes: Uster Statistics Bulletin 是国际通用基准，常被忽略。
rounds.tips_zh: 供应商提供 Bulletin 对比（5%/25%/50%）是国际通用基准参考。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, please include the Uster Statistics Bulletin comparison, ideally 25% better than world level. That will help us close any future claim quickly.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. About cone weight — we can do 1.89 kg paper cones, 24 cones per carton. Does that fit your knitting machine?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 会附上。筒重方面——我们可以做 1.89 公斤纸锥，每箱 24 筒。能配合你厂圆机吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认筒重与上机适配
rounds.common_mistakes: 筒重偏差过大影响染整与排料；要在 PI 写明 ±50 g。
rounds.tips_zh: 1.89 kg 纸锥是国内标准；2 kg 锥需提前与纱厂确认。
rounds.user_response_example: 1.89 kg paper cones fit our circular knitting perfectly. Please keep cone weight tolerance within ±50 grams.

rounds.ai_message: OK. Final price for compact 32s, 500 kg × 4 colors, is US$4.05 per kg, FOB Shanghai. TT 30/70 with 30% deposit. Lead time 25 days after lab dip approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。紧密纺 32 支、500 公斤 × 4 色，最终价每公斤 4.05 美元，FOB 上海。付款 TT 30/70，定金 30%。批色样后 25 天交期。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认付款条件与交期
rounds.common_mistakes: TT 30/70 = 30% deposit + 70% balance against B/L copy。
rounds.tips_zh: 30% 定金、70% 凭提单复印件付清是国内出口标准条款。
rounds.user_response_example: TT 30/70 is fine. We will arrange the 30% deposit this week. 25 days lead time is confirmed on our side too.

rounds.ai_message: Perfect. I will send the PI by tomorrow with all specs, Uster limits, cone weight and payment terms. Looking forward to working with you.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 完美。我明天发 PI，含所有规格、Uster 上限、筒重和付款条件。期待合作。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认收件邮箱，期待合作
rounds.common_mistakes: 结尾要确认邮箱；不要只口头说谢谢。
rounds.tips_zh: 长期合作要在首次订单就明确 Uster 报告格式与索赔时限。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send the PI to mark@lilygarments.com. We are looking forward to a long-term cooperation. Have a nice day.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Lisa from Yibin Yarn. I have your RFQ for compact 32s combed cotton for our premium line. Before I commit, I need to flag a market issue — cotton futures are up 8% this month. Can you lock a price today, or should we quote with a 7-day validity?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是宜宾纱业 Lisa。看到你高档线紧凑纺 32 支精梳棉的 RFQ。报价前要说明——本月棉花期货涨了 8%。你能今天锁价，还是我报 7 天有效期？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在锁价与有效期之间做选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 开口就问 'what is the best price' 在棉花波动期是低效沟通。
rounds.tips_zh: 棉花期货波动期，纱厂报价带 7 天有效期是行业惯例；买方锁价要有量与回款保障。
rounds.user_response_example: We can lock today for the full 2,000 kg, but only if you can hold the price for 14 days until our PI is approved internally.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. For a 2,000 kg commitment, I can hold 14 days at US$4.15 per kg for compact 32s. But I need a written confirmation today — verbal is not enough for this volume.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。2,000 公斤的量我可以 14 天内锁价每公斤 4.15 美元。但今天必须书面确认——口头对这么大的量不够。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 同意书面确认，提出附带条件
key_phrases: we can sign a letter of intent
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要说 'I will confirm tomorrow'——口头在量大时无效。
rounds.tips_zh: 大单锁价要 LOI（意向书）或邮件确认，避免日后扯皮。
rounds.user_response_example: We can sign a letter of intent today by email. The price is subject to our PI being issued within 14 days, and our MD will counter-sign.

rounds.ai_message: OK, LOI accepted. Now about quality — your previous shipment from last season had a Uster CV% of 14.2 on 30s ring spun, which is above our claim threshold of 13.5. We are still discussing that debit note. Will the new lot be tighter?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好，LOI 接受。关于质量——你上批 30 支环锭纺 Uster CV% 是 14.2，超过我方索赔阈值 13.5。借记通知还在谈。这批会收紧吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 承认上次问题，提出新批次的 QC 改善
key_phrases: we have re-calibrated the ring frame
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要回避历史问题；坦诚 + 改善方案是最好回应。
rounds.tips_zh: 上批 CV% 偏高往往是牵伸齿轮磨损或温湿度控制问题；改善方案要具体。
上批 CV% 偏高往往是牵伸齿轮磨损或温湿度控制问题；改善方案要具体。
rounds.user_response_example: We acknowledge the 14.2 issue and have re-calibrated the ring frame draft gears. We can guarantee Uster CV% below 13.0 this lot, with a third-party Uster verification if needed.

rounds.ai_message: Good to hear. But the debit note on lot #A203 is still open — US$1,850 for 800 kg affected. Are you proposing to settle it on this new order, or keep it separate?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好消息。但 A203 批次的借记通知还没结——800 公斤受影响，1,850 美元。你打算在这笔新单上抵，还是分开处理？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在抵账与分开之间做选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 抵账会让本笔订单账面利润变薄，但现金流更好——要权衡。
rounds.tips_zh: 抵账 vs 贷记通知 vs 单独索赔各有税务和现金流差异，提前与财务对齐。
rounds.user_response_example: Let's settle the A203 debit against this new PO. Please issue a credit note for US$1,850 and deduct it from our deposit invoice.

rounds.ai_message: Fair enough. One more thing — your spec says 'combed cotton', but does it need to be long-staple cotton from Xinjiang or US Pima, or is regular upland cotton acceptable?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 合理。再确认一下——你规格写 'combed cotton'，要新疆长绒棉或美国 Pima 棉，还是普通细绒棉可以？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明棉种要求
rounds.common_mistakes: 长绒棉（long-staple）vs 细绒棉（upland）价格差 30-50%；不要混说。
rounds.tips_zh: 高档 T 恤用 Pima 或新疆长绒棉；普通 T 恤用细绒棉。
rounds.user_response_example: For our premium line we need Xinjiang long-staple cotton. Please confirm the fiber length is above 35 mm and the micronaire between 3.7 and 4.2.

rounds.ai_message: Confirmed Xinjiang long-staple, average length 36 mm, micronaire 3.9. Last question — your PI specifies delivery in two equal lots. Can you commit to that, or do you need a single-batch shipment?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 已确认新疆长绒棉，平均长度 36 mm，马克隆值 3.9。最后一个问题——你 PI 要求分两批等量交货。你能承诺分批吗？还是要求单批？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认分批方案
key_phrases: we need single batch for our knitting
rounds.common_mistakes: 分批交期会增加物流成本和库存压力，需提前沟通。
rounds.tips_zh: 分批交货可降低纱厂产能压力，但要约定两批色光一致性。
rounds.user_response_example: Two equal lots is fine, 30 days apart. Please confirm both lots will use the same spinning lot number to avoid shade variation.

rounds.ai_message: Yes, same lot for both halves. About LC terms — last season you opened a confirmed L/C at sight. Will this order follow the same payment structure, or do you prefer TT 30/70?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以，两批同一批号。关于付款方式——上季你开的是保兑即期信用证。这单按同样方式，还是改 TT 30/70？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在信用证与 TT 之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 信用证成本高（开证费 + 银行保证金）但对买卖双方都安全。
rounds.tips_zh: 首次合作或大单建议 L/C；成熟客户可改 TT 30/70 省成本。
rounds.user_response_example: For this volume and given our 5-year history, TT 30/70 makes more sense. Saves us both the L/C opening fee and your bank charges.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed. I will issue the PI today with: 2,000 kg compact 32s Xinjiang long-staple at US$4.15, FOB Shanghai, two equal lots 30 days apart, same spinning lot, TT 30/70, and the A203 credit note deducted. Please counter-sign by Friday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。我今天发 PI：2,000 公斤紧密纺 32 支新疆长绒棉，每公斤 4.15 美元，FOB 上海，分两批间隔 30 天同一批号，TT 30/70，并扣减 A203 贷记通知。请在周五前回签。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认收到 PI，安排内部审批
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 收到后要先核对所有条款再签字；不要急着签字。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 回签前要核对：单价、MOQ、交期、付款、Uster 上限、批号、贷记扣减。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. We will verify all terms with our MD and counter-sign by Friday. The deposit will be wired the same day we sign.
